segments.text:
V. 34.
The Lord hath appeared to Simon —Before he was ſeen of the twelve Apoſtles, 1 Cor. xv. 5. He had, in his wonderful Condeſcenſion and Grace, taken an Opportunity on the former Part of that Day (tho' where, or in what Manner, is not recorded) to ſhew Himſelf to Peter, that He might early relieve his Diſtreſſes and Fears, on Account of having ſo ſhamefully denied his Maſter.
